topic: Capstone Testing, Visualization, Documentation, and Presentation
learningObjectives: Validate the capstone pipeline and model using appropriate tests and metrics.
Create visualizations that communicate project findings clearly.
Prepare concise technical documentation and a project presentation.

activities.title: Testing Strategy
activities.instruction: Connect each project component with an appropriate type of test.

content.concept: Testing verifies data processing, model behavior, API responses, and end-to-end pipeline reliability.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Checks whether incoming or processed data meets expected rules.
Tests an individual function or component in isolation.
Measures model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
Checks whether an API accepts requests and returns expected responses.
Checks whether multiple components work together correctly.
Validates the complete workflow from input to final output.

activities.title: Visualization Selector
activities.instruction: Match each analytical goal with an appropriate visualization.

content.concept: Effective visualizations match the chart type to the data relationship and communication goal.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Show a Trend Over Time → Line Chart
Show Relationship Between Two Numerical Variables → Scatter Plot

activities.title: Documentation Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the essential sections of technical project documentation.

content.concept: Technical documentation explains the project's purpose, data, methodology, results, setup, usage, and limitations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Describes the source, structure, and important characteristics of the data.
Explains the analytical and machine learning approach.
Describes the major components and implementation details.
Presents metrics, findings, and relevant visualizations.
Explains how another person can install, run, or use the project.
Documents current limitations and possible improvements.

activities.title: Presentation Builder
activities.instruction: Build a clear presentation flow for the capstone project.

content.concept: A clear presentation connects the problem, approach, evidence, results, limitations, and future work.
